'''Fire Blast''' is a [[Fire spells|fire]]-based [[Blast spells|blast spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 59 [[Magic]] to cast. As an [[Combat spells#Offensive spells|offensive combat spell]] it can only be cast on [[Monster|attackable NPCs]], or other players in a [[Player killing|PvP situation]].

It is the strongest fire spell available to [[free-to-play]] players.

==Damage==
Fire Blast has a base maximum hit of 16. As with all combat spells, Fire Blast's maximum hit is increased based on the player's [[Magic damage|magic damage bonus]].

As a fire-based spell, Fire Blast's maximum hit is also increased against targets that are [[Elemental weakness|weak to fire]].

=== Maximum hit ===
While wearing gear with high magic damage bonus, Fire Blast's maximum hit can be increased up to 24. Wearing a [[Slayer helmet (i)|slayer helm (i)]] while on a Slayer task can further increase the maximum hit to 26.

== Notable uses ==

* During the [[Family Crest]] quest, the player must deal damage to the demon [[Chronozon]] with Fire Blast (along with each of the other three blast spells) at least once in order to defeat it.
